  <div class="chaos-note">
    <h2>Strange attractors</h2>
    <p>This is the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lorenz_system" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Lorenz attractor</a> — three simple equations, integrated forward, that never repeat and never settle. Two starting points a millionth apart end up somewhere completely different. That sensitivity is the whole idea behind <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaos_theory" target="_blank" rel="noopener">chaos theory</a>.</p>
    <p>I find these mathematical visualizations genuinely beautiful, and they are a large part of why I ended up in robotics. The same nonlinear dynamics show up the moment you try to balance a pendulum on a moving cart, which is exactly what Lab 12 turned into.</p>
  </div>
